# Okanagan Roam

> A free local guide to the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia, Canada. It lists 1,700+ wineries, restaurants, breweries, cafes, beaches, trails and activities, with opening hours, happy hours and seasonal hours checked against each place, plus this week's events, a near-me map and a free trip planner. Pages are in English and French (French pages start with /fr/).

Each listing shows its address, map location, opening hours and the date those hours were last checked. Hours change by season, so the listing's own notes (for example "off-season until March") are the most current detail. The site is independent and listings are free.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://okanaganroam.com/): search every place, see what's open now
- [Roam Now map](https://okanaganroam.com/map): what's open near you and this week's events on a map
- [What's On](https://okanaganroam.com/whats-on): events across the Okanagan
- [Build My Trip](https://okanaganroam.com/trip): free day-by-day trip planner
- [Guides](https://okanaganroam.com/guides): seasonal and themed guides (fall, winter, brunch, patios, wineries, dog-friendly)
- [Browse & Search](https://okanaganroam.com/browse): every place, with filters (dog-friendly, kid-friendly, vegan, gluten-free, happy hour, free entry)
- [About](https://okanaganroam.com/about): who runs the site and why

Listing pages follow the pattern https://okanaganroam.com/{town}/{category}/{place}, for example https://okanaganroam.com/kelowna/wineries/tantalus-vineyards.
